stem: Which is known as 'Roof of the World'?
expl: The Pamir Plateau or the “Pamir’’ is called the roof of the world because of its high altitude. The southern border of Central Asia is determined by the Pamir Plateau. It is a convergence of many mountains.

stem: Telegraphic Plateau is a part of :
